name: APIVerveFortuneCookieGenerator
summary: Fortune Cookie Generator creates authentic fortune cookie messages including wisdom, predictions, advice, humor, and motivational quotes.
description:
Fortune Cookie Generator creates authentic fortune cookie messages including wisdom, predictions, advice, humor, and motivational quotes.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Fortune Cookie Generator from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
